origin.description: Peaks as rows of value, index, left index, and right index. Indices stay 1-based.
origin.usage: findpeaks(x, nups = 1, ndowns = nups, zero = '0', peakpat = NULL, minpeakheight = -Inf, minpeakdistance = 1, threshold = 0, npeaks = 0, sortstr = FALSE)

arguments.name: nups
arguments.text: Rising samples required before a peak.

arguments.name: ndowns
arguments.text: Falling samples required after a peak.

arguments.name: zero
arguments.text: Character used for a flat step.

arguments.name: npeaks
arguments.text: Maximum number of peaks. 0 keeps them all.
